sections.heading: Why Invest
sections.text:
Why Invest
Oman is quickly becoming one of the most prominent commercial and cultural hubs in the region and is rapidly becoming a prime investment destination due to its attractive benefits. From its favorable tax environment and its strategic location as a gateway to the Middle East and Africa, Oman offers countless opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive.
Life-time Residency Visa: for investors on projects in the itc
Upcoming railway project: connecting UAE to Muscat, Oman
100% Freehold: Ownership for all nationalities
0%: Personal Income tax
0%: Capital Gains tax
0% Inheritance tax: Oman applies the inheritance laws of the owner’s country of origin, not local laws.
25 years exemption from corporate income taxes: for special economic/free zone
Stable and Growing Economy: Current inflation rate is one of the lowest globally.
One: Of the Safest Countries in the world
Ideal Location: easy access to the gulf, the Indian subcontinent and Africa
A Tourism Hub: High potential for growth, projected earnings of 22.5bn USD by 2040.
Cosmopolitan Home: to a vibrant expat and foreign investor community with over 100 nationalities
Saudi-Oman Highway:: Cuts travel by 16 hours, driving tourism and investment.
